description: Document what the If-Match config version on PatchConfig and PutConfig must be. The spec only says "Config version for optimistic concurrency control." Live probes on 2026-10-02 (see config-version-conflict.patch.json) showed the version is scoped to the request's keys: the config_version of a GET with `keys` set to exactly the keys being written succeeds, and the full-document GET version is rejected with 409 config_version_conflict.

patches.value: Config version for optimistic concurrency control. Must be the config_version from getConfig with `keys` set to exactly the keys being written; the config_version of a full-document read is rejected with ConfigVersionConflict.
